description: r61 (PLAN D10/D11, track D, H200 promotion gate for a self-imitation arm): D 005's RL phase from D 005's own pretrained checkpoints (same seed), time-budgeted as in the record (no step cap, so the replay's update time counts), with r59's self-imitation (INBOX 2026-11-10 14:50): up to 64 replayed verifier-correct completions per step from this run's own buffer (4096, empty at the start, verbatim, the verifier the only filter), drawn evenly over levels, coefficient 0.5. r59 (B200, step-capped, from D 004's checkpoints) gave 0.278 / 0.248 / 0.232 against r30's 0.192 / 0.180 / 0.220 (paired +0.055).
